title: Grateful Dead Live at Des Moines Civic Center on 1981-12-07
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXL-II); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a decent show – highlights include “The Music Never Stands” and “Saint of Circumstance,” but the mix is uneven.
ai_review.review: The performance is solid for an ’81 winter run, delivering strong moments like TMNS, Deep Elem Blues, Althea and a fiery second‑set stretch beginning with Saint of Circumstance. Listeners note that the soundboard tape suffers from a wonky mix – Brent’s keyboards sit too high while Jerry’s guitar can get buried – yet it remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is generally good with several standout songs, but recording mix issues lower the overall enjoyment; weighted rating reflects this balance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix feels off – keyboards (Brent) are overly prominent and Jerry’s guitar is not as forward as desired. Overall clarity is acceptable for a soundboard but the balance detracts from the experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is respectable but somewhat uneven; the second set really lifts off with a strong Saint of Circumstance opening and an energetic closing jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Some reviewers wish his guitar was more dominant in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard levels are described as too high and generally out of balance.
